The explicit rational uniformizer s yields semigroup rings K[s^2,s^m] or K[s^2,s^(m-2)] at the exceptional height-one prime; odd numerical-semigroup gaps prove the lengths and conductor. z^(m-1) is integral over (x,y), proving equal normalized modifications. Regression code checks identities for 3<=m<=41, but the formal argument covers all odd m and no finite sample is treated as the proof.

value.rationale: The ordinary Nash blowup is a natural resolution operation for rational double points; normalized toric fan data are provably insensitive to characteristic. The exact generic codimension-one nonnormality and conductor of the first Nash modification measure precisely what normalization erases. The comparison gives a sharp universal wild jump in an entire natural A-type family, including an abrupt smooth-to-cuspidal transition at m=3, useful for studying unnormalized iteration and exceptional fibres. These are motivated structural birational invariants, not an arbitrary finite slice or a known-table recomputation.
